The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they almost left the night before you arrived unless you give them a reason to say it first. If that truth surfaces at Black dressing room, Mask Lane, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
